long.title: New Orleans by Train 🚆 Summer Dusk Lofi Window Ride | 5-Minute Chillhop Journey
long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated New Orleans on a warm summer evening: French Quarter balconies glowing with lamplight, St. Louis Cathedral, a paddle-wheel steamboat on the Mississippi and the skyline at dusk, with fireflies and mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.title: Train ride through the French Quarter at dusk ✨ #lofi #neworleans #shorts
short_1.summary: Lamplit French Quarter balconies on a warm summer evening, then a ride along the Mississippi past St. Louis Cathedral, with mellow lofi beats.

short_2.title: Lofi train window: the Mississippi at dusk 🌅 #lofi #neworleans #shorts
short_2.summary: The New Orleans skyline glowing over the Mississippi at dusk, with St. Louis Cathedral and lamplit balconies passing the train window and mellow lofi beats.
